mapper.select: SELECT proj_id AS "id",proj_stat_cd AS "status",ctrt_end_dt AS "endDate" FROM tb_pj_proj WHERE proj_id=#{id}

SELECT s.user_id AS "userId",s.scope_sn AS "scopeSn",s.proj_id AS "projectId",u.user_nm AS "name" FROM tb_sy_user_scope s JOIN tb_sy_user u ON u.user_id=s.user_id WHERE s.proj_id=#{id} AND s.scope_type_cd='PROJ' ORDER BY s.user_id,s.scope_sn

SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM tb_sy_user u JOIN tb_sy_user_role ur ON ur.user_id=u.user_id JOIN tb_sy_role r ON r.role_id=ur.role_id WHERE u.user_id=#{userId} AND u.user_stat_cd='USE' AND r.role_id='PM' AND r.use_yn='Y')
SELECT COALESCE(max(scope_sn),0) FROM tb_sy_user_scope WHERE user_id=#{userId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM tb_sy_user_scope WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND scope_sn=#{scopeSn} AND scope_type_cd='PROJ' AND proj_id=#{projectId}
